scanNote:
6-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (41-bet) - O'QISh.

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Food, Glorious Food' va PUShTI-QIZIL yorliqda oq '6'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq sarlavha 'Reading'.
5) 'Read the article and for questions 1 - 5, choose the best answer, A, B, C or D. Then, explain the words in bold.'
  MAQOLA (och ko'k fonda, yirtiq qog'oz shaklida):
  Ko'k katta harflar bilan 'What Do The Stars Eat?', ostida va ustida ko'k nuqtali chiziq.
  O'ngda SURAT: uzun qora sochli, ko'k kurtkali ayol (Whoopi Goldberg).
  Matn ikki ustunda, ba'zi so'zlar QALIN.
• Pastda ikki ustunda 1 va 2-savollar (A-D variantlari).

O'NG USTUN:
• Yuqorida 3, 4 va 5-savollar (A-D variantlari), vertikal chiziqlar bilan ajratilgan.
• Katta to'q sariq sarlavha 'Language Development'.
6) 'Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Qiya ro'yxat: dry, foods, eating, junk, freshly-squeezed, calories, poached, steamed, strict. Ikki ustunda 9 ta nuqtali band.
7) 'Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Sakkiz ibora bir xatboshida: 1 ... film sets; 2 ... a diet; 3 ninety-nine per cent ... the time; 4 to insist ... sth; 5 to worry ... sth; 6 to cook ... sb; 7 to complain ... sth; 8 to think ... sth
8) 'Replace the words in bold with the correct word from the list.' Qiya ro'yxat: constantly, fatty, wondered about, insists on. To'rtta gap, qalin so'zlar bilan.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking'.
  'Read the article again, and make notes about the stars and their eating habits under these headings:' Uch ko'k qalin sarlavha: • dieters • junk-food lovers • fussy eaters
  'Then, use your notes to talk about what the stars like to eat. Start like this:'
  Ko'k qiya: 'Some actors only eat low-fat foods. For example, Demi Moore enjoys Basmati rice ...'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '41'.

exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLANING TO'LIQ MATNI VA
TARJIMASI bandlarda berilgan.


⚠ MAQOLA HAQIDA:

  Ikki oshpaz-ta'minotchi (John Sharp
  va Susan Tate) kino yulduzlarining
  ovqatlanish odatlari haqida
  gapiradi.


⚠ QALIN SO'ZLAR - 5-MAShQDA
  TUShUNTIRILADI:

  dating, wondered about, chefs,
  caterers, film sets, eating habits,
  strict, constantly on a diet,
  insist on, filming, steamed,
  worry about, fixed, complain about,
  sits, snack


⚠ 'A STAR' bu yerda:

  = mashhur aktyor/aktrisa.


⚠ MAQOLADAGI ISMLAR:

  John Sharp - oshpaz (chef)
  Susan Tate - ta'minotchi (caterer)
  Demi Moore, Helen Hunt,
  Eddie Murphy, Whoopi Goldberg,
  Bill Murray, Mickey Rourke -
  kino yulduzlari
  Michelle Pfeiffer, Al Pacino -
  yana ikki yulduz

  ⚠ 'Now and Then' va 'Twister' -
  filmlar nomi (QIYa harflarda).

points.en: Film stars are everyone's favourite subject. People love to talk about what they're wearing, who they're dating, and how much money they make. But have you ever wondered about what they eat?
points.uz: Kino yulduzlari - hammaning sevimli mavzusi. Odamlar ular nima kiyayotgani, kim bilan uchrashayotgani va qancha pul ishlayotgani haqida gapirishni yaxshi ko'radi. Lekin ular nima yeydi deb hech o'ylab ko'rganmisiz?
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to date sb' = kim bilandir uchrashmoq
(sevishganlar).
⚠ 'to wonder about' = qiziqmoq, o'ylab ko'rmoq.
⚠ 'to make money' = pul ishlamoq.

points.en: Chefs and caterers on film sets have the answers. "Every actor has different eating habits," says chef John Sharp.
points.uz: Kino maydonchalaridagi oshpazlar va ta'minotchilarda javob bor. "Har bir aktyorning ovqatlanish odatlari har xil", - deydi oshpaz Jon Sharp.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a chef' = professional oshpaz (/ʃef/).
⚠ 'a caterer' = ovqat bilan ta'minlovchi.
⚠ 'a film set' = kino suratga olish maydonchasi.

points.en: "Some stars love meat, while others are strict vegetarians who don't eat meat, eggs, or fish. Some stars love junk food, while others are constantly on a diet and eat only healthy foods."
points.uz: "Ba'zi yulduzlar go'shtni yaxshi ko'radi, boshqalari esa go'sht, tuxum va baliq yemaydigan qat'iy vegetarianlar. Ba'zi yulduzlar foydasiz ovqatni yaxshi ko'radi, boshqalari esa doim parhezda va faqat sog'lom ovqat yeydi".
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'strict' = qat'iy.
⚠ 'constantly' = doimo.
⚠ 'while' bu yerda = holbuki, esa
(qarama-qarshilik).

points.en: Ninety-nine per cent of the time, actresses are on a diet and insist on eating only low-fat foods.
points.uz: Vaqtning to'qson to'qqiz foizida aktrisalar parhezda bo'lib, faqat kam yog'li ovqat yeyishni talab qiladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'per cent OF the time' - 'of' predlogi.
⚠ 'to insist ON' + -ING.

points.en: During the filming of Now and Then, Demi Moore ate nothing but Basmati rice, steamed baby spinach, green beans with lemon, and turkey sandwiches on wholemeal bread.
points.uz: 'Now and Then' filmini suratga olish paytida Demi Mur faqat basmati guruch, bug'da pishirilgan yosh ismaloq, limonli yashil loviya va to'liq donli nondagi kurka sendvichlarini yedi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'nothing but' = faqat, boshqa hech narsa.
⚠ 'steamed' = bug'da pishirilgan.
⚠ 'a sandwich ON wholemeal bread' - 'on'
predlogi.

points.en: During the filming of Twister, Helen Hunt only ate low-calorie foods, including poached eggs, dry toast, and steamed brown rice with vegetables.
points.uz: 'Twister' filmini suratga olish paytida Helen Xant faqat kam kaloriyali ovqat yedi: suvda pishirilgan tuxum, quruq tost va sabzavotli bug'da pishirilgan jigarrang guruch.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'low-calorie' - DEFIS bilan.
⚠ 'dry toast' = sariyog'siz tost.
⚠ 'including' = ... jumladan.

points.en: Other stars love to eat junk food, and never count calories during their meals. Eddie Murphy's favourite food is Kentucky Fried Chicken.
points.uz: Boshqa yulduzlar foydasiz ovqat yeyishni yaxshi ko'radi va ovqat paytida hech qachon kaloriya sanamaydi. Eddi Merfining sevimli taomi - Kentucky Fried Chicken.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to count calories' = kaloriya sanamoq.
⚠ 'a meal' = ovqatlanish.

points.en: Whoopi Goldberg doesn't worry about how healthy her diet is, and loves fatty bacon sandwiches with lettuce, mayonnaise and lots of butter.
points.uz: Vupi Goldberg ovqatlanishi qanchalik sog'lomligidan xavotir olmaydi va salat bargi, mayonez va ko'p sariyog' bilan yog'li bekonli sendvichlarni yaxshi ko'radi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to worry ABOUT' - 'about' predlogi.
⚠ 'butter' - SANALMAYDIGAN → 'LOTS OF butter'.

points.en: One thing for sure is that cooking for the stars is never easy, because they are often fussy eaters.
points.uz: Aniq bir narsa: yulduzlarga ovqat pishirish hech qachon oson emas, chunki ular ko'pincha injiq yeguvchilar.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'for sure' = aniq.
⚠ 'to cook FOR sb' - 'for' predlogi.
⚠ 'a fussy eater' - 40-betda ham bor edi.

points.en: "They want food fixed exactly the way they like it and always have something to complain about," says caterer Susan Tate.
points.uz: "Ular ovqat aynan o'zlari xohlagandek tayyorlanishini istaydi va doim shikoyat qiladigan narsa topadi", - deydi ta'minotchi Syuzan Teyt.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'fixed' bu yerda = tayyorlangan (AQSh usuli).
⚠ 'to complain ABOUT' - 'about' predlogi.
⚠ 'the way they like it' = o'zlari xohlagandek.

points.en: Bill Murray won't eat watermelon with seeds in it, and Mickey Rourke insists on freshly-squeezed carrot juice twice a day, but he won't drink it if it sits for more than six minutes.
points.uz: Bill Marrey urug'li tarvuzni yemaydi, Mikki Rurk esa kuniga ikki marta yangi siqilgan sabzi sharbatini talab qiladi, lekin agar u olti daqiqadan ortiq tursa, ichmaydi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ "won't" bu yerda = QAT'IY rad etish
('will' ning bu ma'nosi ham bor).
⚠ 'to sit' bu yerda = turmoq, qolmoq.

points.en: Cooking for the stars is hard work, but few of these caterers ever think about changing jobs. "I love my work," says Susan Tate.
points.uz: Yulduzlarga ovqat pishirish - og'ir mehnat, lekin bu ta'minotchilarning ozchiligi ish almashtirish haqida o'ylaydi. "Men ishimni yaxshi ko'raman", - deydi Syuzan Teyt.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'FEW' (artiklsiz) = juda oz (salbiy ma'no).
⚠ 'A few' = bir nechta (ijobiy).
⚠ 'to think ABOUT' + -ING.

points.en: "Where else can I see what Michelle Pfeiffer eats for breakfast or what Al Pacino has for a snack?"
points.uz: "Michelle Pfeiffer nonushtaga nima yeyishini yoki Al Pachino tamaddiga nima olishini yana qayerda ko'ra olaman?"
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'for breakfast' - ARTIKLSIZ.
⚠ 'for A snack' - artikl BOR.
⚠ 'to have sth for a snack' = tamaddiga
nimadir olmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article and for questions 1 - 5, choose the best answer, A, B, C or D.
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani o'qing va 1-5 savollar uchun eng to'g'ri javobni tanlang: A, B, C yoki D.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh TEST SAVOLI.


JAVOBLAR:

  1 C (meat)
    Matnda: 'strict vegetarians who
    don't eat MEAT, eggs, or fish'.

  2 C (fatty foods)
    Matnda: 'actresses are on a diet
    and insist on eating only
    LOW-FAT foods' - demak yog'li
    ovqat yemaydi.

  3 A (Eddie Murphy)
    Matnda: "Eddie Murphy's favourite
    food is Kentucky Fried Chicken"
    (junk food).

  4 B (difficult)
    Matnda: 'cooking for the stars is
    NEVER EASY' va 'is HARD WORK'.

  5 D (fix food the way each star
     likes it)
    Matnda: 'They want food fixed
    exactly THE WAY THEY LIKE IT'.


⚠ 5-SAVOLDAGI TUZOQLAR:

  A 'be fussy eaters' - YULDUZLAR
    injiq, ta'minotchilar emas!
  B 'prepare only healthy food' -
    yo'q, ba'zi yulduzlar junk food
    xohlaydi.
  C 'change their jobs often' -
    matnda TESKARI: 'FEW ... ever
    think about changing jobs'.


⚠ BUNDAY TESTNI QANDAY BAJARISh:

  1) Savolni o'qing
  2) Matndan tegishli JOYni toping
  3) To'rt variantni matndagi gap
     bilan solishtiring
  4) MA'NODOShLARGA diqqat:
     'never easy' = 'difficult'

items.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda: 'strict vegetarians who don't eat
MEAT, eggs, or fish'.

⚠ Matnda: 'insist on eating only LOW-FAT foods'
- demak YOG'LI ovqat yemaydi.

⚠ Matnda: "Eddie Murphy's favourite food is
Kentucky Fried Chicken" - bu junk food.
⚠ Demi Moore parhezda, Susan Tate - ta'minotchi.

⚠ Matnda: 'cooking for the stars is NEVER EASY'
va 'is HARD WORK'.
⚠ 'never easy' = 'difficult'.

items.uz: Kino maydonchasidagi ta'minotchilar nima qilishi kerak?
options: fix food the way each star likes it
items.answer: fix food the way each star likes it
items.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda: 'They want food FIXED EXACTLY THE WAY
THEY LIKE IT'.
⚠ 'be fussy eaters' - YULDUZLAR injiq, ta'minotchi
emas!

exercises.instructionEn: Then, explain the words in bold.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLADAGI QALIN SO'ZLAR.


⚠ 'A CHEF' va 'A COOK':

  chef = professional oshpaz
     (restoranda, boshliq)
  cook = ovqat pishiruvchi (umuman)

  ⚠ 'chef' o'qilishi /ʃef/ - 'ch'
  /ʃ/ deb o'qiladi (fransuz so'zi).


⚠ 'A CATERER':

  = ovqat bilan ta'minlovchi
  (tadbirlarda, kino maydonchasida).
  ⚠ 'to cater FOR sb' = ovqat bilan
  ta'minlamoq.


⚠ 'A FILM SET':

  = kino suratga olish maydonchasi.
  ⚠ 'ON a film set' - 'on' predlogi.


⚠ 'TO FIX FOOD':

  = ovqat tayyorlamoq (AQSh usuli).
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'to prepare food'
  yoki 'to make food'.
  ⚠ 'to fix' odatda = tuzatmoq!


⚠ 'TO SIT' - G'AYRIODATIY MA'NO:

  'if it SITS for more than six
   minutes' = agar olti daqiqadan
  ortiq TURSA.
  ⚠ 'o'tirmoq' EMAS!

points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to date sb' - PREDLOGSIZ.
⚠ 'a date' = uchrashuv.

⚠ 'to wonder ABOUT' - 'about' predlogi.
⚠ 8-mashqda ham kerak bo'ladi.
⚠ O'qilishi /ʃefs/ - 'ch' /ʃ/ deb o'qiladi.
⚠ 'to cater FOR sb' = ta'minlamoq.
⚠ 'ON a film set' - 'on' predlogi (7-mashq).

⚠ 'a habit' = odat.
⚠ 6-mashqda ham kerak bo'ladi.

⚠ 'a strict vegetarian' = qat'iy vegetarian.
⚠ 6-mashqda ham kerak bo'ladi.

⚠ 'constantly' = doimo.
⚠ 'ON a diet' - 'on' predlogi.

⚠ 'to insist ON' + -ING yoki ot.
⚠ 'insist to' - XATO!

⚠ 'to film' = suratga olmoq.
⚠ 'during the filming OF' - 'of' predlogi.

⚠ 'steam' = bug'.
⚠ Eng sog'lom pishirish usullaridan biri.

⚠ 'to worry ABOUT' - 'about' predlogi.
⚠ 'worry for' - XATO.

⚠ Britaniyada 'prepared' yoki 'made'.
⚠ 'to fix' odatda = tuzatmoq!

⚠ 'to complain ABOUT' - 'about' predlogi.
⚠ 'to complain TO sb ABOUT sth' - to'liq qolip.

⚠ 'o'tiradi' EMAS!
⚠ Bu yerda: sharbat tayyorlangandan keyin
turib qolsa.

⚠ 'for A snack' - artikl BOR.
⚠ 'for breakfast/lunch/dinner' - artiklSIZ.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA IBORA MAQOLADA BOR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  EATING habits
     - ovqatlanish odatlari
  STEAMED brown rice
     - bug'da pishirilgan jigarrang
       guruch
  JUNK food
     - foydasiz ovqat
  low-fat FOODS
     - kam yog'li ovqatlar
  POACHED eggs
     - suvda pishirilgan tuxum
  DRY toast
     - quruq tost
  to count CALORIES
     - kaloriya sanamoq
  FRESHLY-SQUEEZED carrot juice
     - yangi siqilgan sabzi sharbati
  STRICT vegetarians
     - qat'iy vegetarianlar


⚠ 4-BANDGA DIQQAT - 'FOODS':

  'low-fat FOODS' - KO'PLIKDA!
  ⚠ 'food' odatda sanalmaydigan,
  lekin TURLARI haqida gapirganda
  'foods' bo'ladi.


⚠ 'DRY TOAST':

  = sariyog'siz tost.
  ⚠ 'toast' - SANALMAYDIGAN!
  ⚠ 'a toast' = qadah so'zi (tost
  aytish) - BOShQA ma'no.
  ⚠ 'a slice/piece of toast' ✓


⚠ 'CALORIES' - KO'PLIKDA:

  'to count CALORIES' - sanaydigan
  narsa, shuning uchun ko'plikda.


⚠ 'STRICT':

  = qat'iy.
  ⚠ Odam haqida ham: 'a strict
  teacher' = qattiqqo'l o'qituvchi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri predlogni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR - HAMMASI MAQOLADA BOR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  ON film sets
     - kino maydonchalarida
  ON a diet
     - parhezda
  ninety-nine per cent OF the time
     - vaqtning 99 foizida
  to insist ON sth
     - qat'iy talab qilmoq
  to worry ABOUT sth
     - xavotir olmoq
  to cook FOR sb
     - kimgadir ovqat pishirmoq
  to complain ABOUT sth
     - shikoyat qilmoq
  to think ABOUT sth
     - o'ylamoq


⚠ 'ABOUT' - UCh FE'L BILAN:

  worry about, complain about,
  think about
  ⚠ Yana: 'wonder about' (5-mashq).


⚠ 'TO INSIST ON':

  ⚠ 'ON' + -ING yoki ot:
     'insist ON eating'
     'insist ON fresh juice'
  ⚠ 'insist TO' - XATO!


⚠ 'TO COOK FOR SB':

  ⚠ 'cook TO sb' - XATO.
  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'buy sth FOR sb',
  'make sth FOR sb'.


⚠ 'TO THINK ABOUT' va 'TO THINK OF':

  think about = o'ylab ko'rmoq
     (uzoq, chuqur)
  think of = eslamoq, tasavvur
     qilmoq

  ⚠ 'What do you THINK OF it?' =
  Bu haqda fikring qanday?


⚠ 'SB' va 'STH':

  sb = somebody (kimdir)
  sth = something (nimadir)
  ⚠ Lug'atlarda ishlatiladigan
  qisqartmalar.


⚠ 'PER CENT':

  ⚠ Britaniyada AJRATIB: 'per cent'.
  ⚠ AQShda QO'ShIB: 'percent'.
  ⚠ '99 per cent OF the time'.

items.whyUz:
⚠ 'ON a film set' - 'on' predlogi.
⚠ Maqolada: 'Chefs and caterers ON FILM SETS'.

⚠ 'ON a diet' - 'on' predlogi ShART.
⚠ 'in a diet' - XATO.

⚠ 'per cent OF' - 'of' predlogi.
⚠ Britaniyada 'per cent' AJRATIB yoziladi.

⚠ 'to insist ON' + -ING yoki ot.
⚠ 'insist to' - XATO!

⚠ 'to cook FOR sb' - 'for' predlogi.
⚠ 'cook to sb' - XATO.

⚠ 'to complain ABOUT' - 'about' predlogi.
⚠ To'liq: 'complain TO sb ABOUT sth'.

⚠ 'to think ABOUT' + -ING.
⚠ 'think OF' = eslamoq, tasavvur qilmoq -
biroz boshqa ma'no.

exercises.instructionEn: Replace the words in bold with the correct word from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin so'zlarni ro'yxatdagi to'g'ri so'z bilan almashtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
MA'NODOShLARNI ALMAShTIRISh.

RO'YXAT: constantly, fatty,
         wondered about, insists on


JAVOBLAR:

  1 asked yourself → WONDERED ABOUT
  2 continuously → CONSTANTLY
  3 demands → INSISTS ON
  4 fattening → FATTY


⚠ 3-BANDGA DIQQAT - ShAKL:

  'Dad always DEMANDS a cup of hot
   milk'
  → 'Dad always INSISTS ON a cup of
     hot milk'

  ⚠ 'demand' PREDLOGSIZ, lekin
  'insist' 'ON' bilan!
  ⚠ Shakl ham 3-shaxs birlik:
  'insistS'.


⚠ 'CONSTANTLY' va 'CONTINUOUSLY':

  constantly = doimo, tez-tez
     takrorlanib
  continuously = uzluksiz,
     to'xtovsiz

  ⚠ Bu yerda deyarli bir xil.


⚠ 'FATTY' va 'FATTENING':

  fatty = yog'li (tarkibida yog'
     ko'p)
  fattening = semirtiruvchi

  ⚠ Deyarli bir xil, lekin
  'fattening' NATIJAga urg'u beradi.


⚠ 'A DIETER':

  = parhezdagi odam.
  ⚠ 'diet' + '-er'.


⚠ 'DAMAGE':

  = zarar.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN!
  ⚠ 'to do damage TO sth' = zarar
  yetkazmoq.


⚠ 'SLIM':

  = nozik, xushbichim.
  ⚠ 'thin' dan ijobiyroq.
  ⚠ 'to stay slim' = nozik qolmoq.


⚠ 'BEDTIME':

  = uxlash vaqti.
  ⚠ QO'ShIB yoziladi.
  ⚠ 'before bedtime' - artiklsiz.

items.textEn: 1 Have you ever ASKED YOURSELF how much damage junk food can do to your body? → Have you ever ___ how much damage junk food can do to your body?
2 Top models are CONTINUOUSLY on a diet to stay slim. → Top models are ___ on a diet to stay slim.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'constantly' = doimo.
⚠ Maqolada ham: 'constantly ON A DIET'.

items.textEn: 3 Dad always DEMANDS a cup of hot milk before bedtime. → Dad always ___ a cup of hot milk before bedtime.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to insist ON' - PREDLOG ShART.
⚠ 'demand' predlogsiz edi, 'insist' esa 'on'
bilan!

items.textEn: 4 Dieters shouldn't eat FATTENING foods. → Dieters shouldn't eat ___ foods.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article again, and make notes about the stars and their eating habits under these headings: dieters, junk-food lovers, fussy eaters. Then, use your notes to talk about what the stars like to eat.
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani qayta o'qing va yulduzlar hamda ularning ovqatlanish odatlari haqida shu sarlavhalar ostida qayd oling: parhezdagilar, foydasiz ovqat sevuvchilar, injiq yeguvchilar. So'ng qaydlaringizdan foydalanib yulduzlar nima yeyishni yoqtirishi haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh SARLAVHA - MAQOLADAN
QAYD OLISh.


1) DIETERS (parhezdagilar):

  • Demi Moore - Basmati rice,
    steamed baby spinach, green
    beans with lemon, turkey
    sandwiches on wholemeal bread
  • Helen Hunt - poached eggs,
    dry toast, steamed brown rice
    with vegetables


2) JUNK-FOOD LOVERS
   (foydasiz ovqat sevuvchilar):

  • Eddie Murphy - Kentucky Fried
    Chicken
  • Whoopi Goldberg - fatty bacon
    sandwiches with lettuce,
    mayonnaise and lots of butter


3) FUSSY EATERS (injiq yeguvchilar):

  • Bill Murray - won't eat
    watermelon with seeds in it
  • Mickey Rourke - insists on
    freshly-squeezed carrot juice
    twice a day, won't drink it if
    it sits for more than six
    minutes


KITOBDAGI BOShLANISh:
  'Some actors only eat low-fat
   foods. For example, Demi Moore
   enjoys Basmati rice ...'


⚠ 'A DIETER':

  = parhezdagi odam.


⚠ 'A JUNK-FOOD LOVER':

  ⚠ DEFIS bilan, chunki 'junk-food'
  sifat vazifasida.


⚠ 'TO ENJOY' + -ING yoki OT:

  'enjoys Basmati rice' ✓
  'enjoys eating rice' ✓
  ⚠ 'enjoy TO eat' - XATO!


⚠ QAYD OLISh QOIDASI:

  ⚠ To'liq gap YoZMANG - faqat
  kalit so'zlar.
